jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Technical Presales & Geospatial Solutions (m/f/d) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) bridges the gap between scientific spatial data research and practical implementation, identifying and evaluating high-value strategic sites for energy storage systems and digital infrastructure. 

What We Offer: 

We provide complete end-to-end support for international candidates under the German Opportunity Card system, including official paperwork, degree validation, housing assistance, and living allowances during the trainee phase. On-site German language courses and direct involvement in high-impact energy infrastructure initiatives are part of the package. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

You will translate spatial data analyses and infrastructure parameters into structured location dossiers and automated B2B lead profiles. You will support technical communications with project partners and institutional stakeholders, while capturing practical industry feedback to continuously refine our spatial queries and research algorithms. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

Applicants should possess a completed degree in Business Engineering, Spatial Economics, Real Estate, Spatial Planning, or Geoinformatics with a commercial mindset. You must have strong communication and organizational skills, an ability to interpret infrastructure maps and site metrics, and fluent English skills. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to our initiative! Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English directly to: 

jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights.

We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. Fluent English is required.

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. 

What We Offer: 

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Early Years Educator / Pädagogische Fachkraft Kindergarten englischsprachig (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (m/w/d)
Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership
• Bringing your own interests, strengths and creative ideas into the daily life of the Kindergarten
• Collaborating respectfully and supportively with colleagues in a bilingual and international team

Your Profile

• Completed qualification or degree in Early Childhood Education, Early Years Education, Childcare, Pedagogy, Social Pedagogy or a comparable field
• Ideally recognised as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria, or willingness to have your qualification checked for recognition
• Professional experience in early childhood education is an advantage
• Excellent English skills at native or near-native level, as you will work as an English-speaking reference person within our bilingual concept
• German language skills are not mandatory at the start
• Willingness and motivation to learn German and develop your language skills over time
• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

Our Benefits

• Attractive and competitive remuneration package                                                                                                   • Annual special payment of up to €1,500 gross, depending on working hours                                                    • Additional employer benefits, for example public transport pass or Edenred City Card
• Free healthy lunch
• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership
• Comprehensive company pension scheme
• Relocation support for work-related moves
• Corporate Benefits Portal
• 34 days of annual leave
• Regular working hours and long-term shift planning for better work-life balance
• Dedicated preparation and planning time, both individually and within the team
• Regular staff meetings during working hours
• Wide range of professional development and training opportunities
• Support in learning German through language courses and everyday practice in an international environment
• Attractively furnished group rooms, children’s kitchen, well-equipped gymnastics room, extensive library and generous outdoor area
• Modern digital equipment, including iPads and smart displays in preschool
• Bilingual teaching teams with up to three qualified pedagogical team members per group
• Support from additional teaching and administrative staff, including music and sports teachers
• Age-oriented groups with dedicated preschool classes
• A warm, international team on a beautiful campus close to the English Garden

Please note

For this position, a relevant early years qualification is required. Applications from international professionals are welcome, provided that a valid work permit for Germany is in place or can be obtained. For qualifications obtained outside Germany, recognition as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria should already be available or be possible to assess.

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

Would you like to support children in a bilingual, international Kindergarten and bring your English language skills into meaningful early years education? Then we look forward to receiving your application via our website.

jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Does shaping your career in a modern digital company where information security plays a central role sound exciting to you? Would you like to further optimize our security level for over 42 million customers and thus make an important contribution to global data and information security? Then you've come to the right place! As a Junior Security Professional in our Security Governance & Assurance team, which is responsible for the strategic aspects of information security at Mail & Media, you can grow into the following tasks:

- Designing and optimizing security-critical processes: You will optimize our internal security policies and guidelines as well as the BCM (Business Continuity Management) System, taking into account internal and external compliance requirements, state-of-the-art technical options, and the interests and structure of the company.
- Conducting security audits and assessments: You carry out audits and assessments in our internal departments as well as at business partners and suppliers, prepare the results in a target group-oriented manner, and support the closure of identified gaps.
- Increasing security awareness: You will contribute to a continuous increase in security awareness within the company by preparing and conducting training courses and presentations for various technical and non-technical target groups.

Are you interested in information security and do you see yourself as an all-rounder and problem solver? Do you have a high affinity for technology and business? Are you open-minded, sociable, and enjoy working with people? Are you characterized by an analytical and structured way of working? Are you able to present complex problems and contexts in a way that is understandable for different target groups? Then we look forward to receiving your application! The following points will increase your chances:

- Degree and training: You have successfully completed or are about to complete a degree in (business) informatics or in a comparable area. You have specialized in information security and/or gained relevant practical experience, e.g., through internships.
- Technical basics and trends: You have sound theoretical technical knowledge and at the same time follow current trends such as AI, digitization, or DevSecOps. You enjoy gaining practical experience that helps you identify security risks in IT infrastructures and propose economic measures.
- Data affinity: You have a high affinity for data and data-driven decisions. Ideally, you have gained experience in the areas of data analysis, data visualization, data science, or process mining during your studies.
- Team player: You are a team player who leads by example at all times. Your commitment, empathy, and continuous willingness to learn will help you gain the necessary trust in the organization.
- Communication skills: Your ability to communicate verbally and in writing in a manner appropriate to the recipient (in German and English, both at C1+ level) rounds off your profile.

jobs.occupation: QA Automation Engineer (IDEA Ultimate QA) (m/f/d) (Qualitätsfachmann/-frau - Fertigungsprüftechnik)
jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers and businesses to grow, discover, and create.

IntelliJ IDEA revolutionized the Java development tool market back in 2001, becoming the first IDE to offer automated code refactoring. It continues to drive innovation in software development, making thousands of programmers more productive every day. In addition to Java, IntelliJ IDEA includes various development tools for other prominent languages such as Ruby, Groovy, Scala, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, PHP, and Kotlin.

About the team

The IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate team is responsible for supporting a wide range of enterprise frameworks, data-access stacks, and application servers in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. This includes technologies such as Spring (including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, and others), Jakarta EE, Quarkus, Micronaut, various reactive and data-access libraries, and popular application servers like Tomcat, WildFly, and Jetty. We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.

We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

Core responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.
- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.
- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.
- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.
- Contribute to frameworks and tools with product-specific extensions as needed.
- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.
- Participate in release quality assessments.
- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.
- Do manual QA activities when needed.
- Participate in the test documentation creation.
- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.
- Work with the tooling team to adopt new frameworks and practices.

What we’re looking for

Required skills:

- Proven experience in test automation.
- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.
- Experience with test frameworks like JUnit or TestNG.
- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.
- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).
- Version control experience (Git).
- Proficiency in spoken and written English.
- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.
- Strong teamwork skills.
- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.

Nice to have:

- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.

**Why join JetBrains?** 

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
- Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
- Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
- Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
- Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
- Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
- Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
- Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Qodana Core) (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

We build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.

In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.

Day to day, you will:

- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.
- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.
- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.
- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.
- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.
- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.

What you’ll bring

- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.
- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.
- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.
- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.
- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.
- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.

What you’ll need

- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).
- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.
- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.

What success looks like

- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.
- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.
- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Unix System Administrator – High-Security IT Operations (m/f/d) (Anwendungssystemadministrator/in)
jobs.description:
Help operate IT systems where reliability and security truly matter.

At Data-Warehouse GmbH, you will work in high-security, mission-critical IT environments where stable systems, precise operations, and a strong security mindset are essential.

We are looking for a Unix System Administrator (m/f/d) with a strong hands-on mentality, solid troubleshooting skills, and the motivation to keep complex IT environments secure, reliable, and well-documented.

You will join an experienced international team and contribute to systems that support demanding stakeholders and security-sensitive projects.

At a glance

- Permanent full-time position
- Immediate start
- Location: Munich north, Germany
- On-site role due to security requirements
- Focus: Unix/Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, secure IT operations
- Security clearance required or willingness to go through the process

Your role

In this position, you will support the operation, administration, and continuous improvement of Unix/Linux-based systems, primarily in Red Hat environments.

Your responsibilities include:

- Administer Unix/Linux-based operating systems, including troubleshooting, installation and setup.
- Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
- Perform backups and recovery using tools such as Netbackup.
- Basic hardware management including racking, card/disk replacements, attaching to network(s), etc.
- Installing third party software following provided instructions.
- Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration.
- Willingness to learn and acquire new skills (including acquiring relevant certifications).
- Willingness to work in a rotation system (to cover the service hours) and to work outside working hours (usually one Saturday per month).

Your profile

- Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar).
- Strong troubleshooting skills for Unix/Linux systems.
- Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.
- Certifications such as RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.
- Good knowledge of English—spoken and written.

Nice to have

- IT related Bachelor or Master degree
- Knowledge of ITIL
- Ability to Shell Script
- Knowledge of Container Technolog, especially Rancher
- VMWare/KVM knowledge
- Windows Server knowledge

What makes this role special

This is not just another system administration role.

You will work in an environment where your contribution has real impact: systems need to be secure, available, well-maintained, and compliant. Your work helps ensure that critical IT infrastructures remain stable and trustworthy.

At the same time, you will have the opportunity to deepen your technical knowledge, gain experience in high-security environments, and develop further through targeted training and certifications.

What we offer

- Permanent employment in a stable, owner-managed German IT company
- Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
- Work on high-security IT and cybersecurity-related projects
- Individual training and development, including certification opportunities
- German courses, if needed
- Relocation support
- Meal allowance through our on-site cafeteria
- Sports and fitness benefits, including company football every two weeks
- A working environment based on trust, responsibility, and long-term cooperation

Important information

Due to the sensitive nature of our projects and the compliance requirements of our stakeholders, this position is fully on-site in the north of Munich. Remote work is not possible.

A security clearance is required. Candidates should either already have the necessary clearance or be willing to go through the process.

Hiring process

Initial remote interview > On-site interview in Munich > Offer > Security clearance process

How to apply

Apply easily — no cover letter required.

Please send us: your CV (in English), earliest possible start date, salary expectations, relevant certificates, if available

No applications from staffing or recruitment companies accepted.

Contact: Doris Böhner | +49 (0)89 660393-0 | jobs@datawh.de (https://mailto:jobs@datawh.de)

About Data-Warehouse GmbH

Data-Warehouse GmbH is an owner-managed German IT company with 35+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information management, software development, and process optimization.

We deliver solutions for high-security environments and combine technological excellence with long-term project expertise.

We support people who take on responsibility, expand their knowledge, and want to develop innovative IT solutions together with us — in an environment where trust, personal responsibility, and a genuine handshake count.
